reference_selection: Up to four nearest earlier and four nearest later covering visits with all three filters in SIA, requiring a majority of usable reference images per pixel.

q1_native_h_rows.status: masked target aperture or local annulus

scope: Observed signed aperture fluxes and robust aperture scatter measured on local control positions. Native Q1 H exposures use the same independent-visit DR1 H reference as the same-date stack. Q1 and DR1 use overlapping August 6 exposures and cannot count as independent observations. No PSF matching or aperture correction.
